decisions.label: Schule
decisions.note: Generic word; the specific schools are separate entries.

decisions.label: Kloster Cronswitz
decisions.note: Brückner also calls it 'Stift'. The plural forms 'Klöster Cronswitz' / 'Klöster zu Cronswitz' name Cronswitz together with another monastery (zum heil. Kreuz, resp. Lausnitz).

decisions.label: Kloster zum heil. Kreuz bei Saalburg
decisions.gloss_en: Monastery of the Holy Cross near Saalburg
decisions.note: Founded about 1310 close to Saalburg (p. 343); Brückner's own article: p. 669. Many occurrences of the bare word 'Kloster' (e.g. 'das Kloster bei Saalburg') also refer to it.

decisions.label: Kloster
decisions.note: Generic word. Often 'das Kloster (bei Saalburg)' = Kloster zum heil. Kreuz; also legendary 'versunkene Klöster' near Schleiz and Arlas.

decisions.label: Deutscher Orden
decisions.note: Brückner: the order settled in the Voigtland in the 13th century with commanderies at Plauen and Schleiz (see Deutsches Haus zu Schleiz). 'deutsche Ordenshaus' (p. 19) names the houses at Plauen and Schleiz together.

decisions.label: Kirche
decisions.note: Generic word (the church as institution or building).

decisions.label: Staatsministerium
decisions.gloss_en: State Ministry (government of the principality, Gera)
decisions.note: Supreme authority of the principality, seat Gera (p. 434); 'Ministerium' without addition (pp. 268, 436) is the same body.

decisions.label: Saline Heinrichshall
decisions.note: Brückner's index: 'Heinrichshall (Pohlitz) 507'.

decisions.label: Chemische Fabrik (Heinrichshall)
decisions.note: Next to the Saline Heinrichshall in the parish of Pohlitz (pp. 38, 505, 507); Brückner's index: 'Chemische Fabrik (Pohlitz) 507'.

decisions.label: Stadtrath
decisions.note: Generic: the municipal council of a town (Lobenstein pp. 719, 722; subscribers: Gera, Lobenstein).

decisions.label: Brüdergemeinde zu Ebersdorf
decisions.note: Moravian (Herrnhut) congregation of Ebersdorf. 'Herrnhutern' (p. 381) = the Moravians in general (the educators of Heinrich LIV.).

decisions.label: Bergkirche zu Schleiz
decisions.gloss_en: Bergkirche (Church of St Mary on the hill), Schleiz
decisions.note: Officially 'St. Marien' (p. 582: 'Kirche zu St. Marien, gewöhnlich die Bergkirche genannt').

decisions.label: Geraer Bank
decisions.note: 'Bank' (p. 431) in the list of Gera buildings is this bank.

decisions.label: Gymnasium Rutheneum zu Gera
decisions.gloss_en: Gymnasium illustre Rutheneum at Gera (state grammar school)
decisions.note: Founded 1608 by Heinrich Posthumus as Gymnasium illustre (Rutheneum), a Landesgymnasium (pp. 375, 435). Bare 'Gymnasium' (pp. 431-437, 444) is this school; 'fürstliche Landesschule zu Gera' (p. 305) is taken as the same school.

decisions.label: Kammergut
decisions.note: Generic: estates managed by the princely chamber; named ones are separate place entries.

decisions.label: Haus Reuß
decisions.note: The ruling house of the principality (Voigte von Weida, Gera and Plauen, later Reuss). 'Reuß' alone (4 of 5 contexts, e.g. p. 362, 577, 767) means the house; 'Reuß-Plauen' (p. 577) is the younger line.

decisions.label: Kaltwasserheilanstalt (Langenberg)
decisions.note: Founded by Dr. Blau at Langenberg (p. 43); 'Wasserheilanstalt' (p. 510) is the same.

decisions.label: Kloster Mildenfurt
decisions.note: Founded 1193 by Heinrich of Weida; 'the oldest monastery of the Voigtland' (p. 329).

decisions.label: Landrentenbank
decisions.note: Proposed institution for redeeming land burdens (p. 229).

decisions.label: Kreisgericht
decisions.note: Subscribers' list p. 837: the courts at Gera and Schleiz.

decisions.label: Hochstift Naumburg
decisions.note: Brückner uses Bisthum/Hochstift Zeitz, Naumburg and Zeitz-Naumburg for the one diocese (seat moved from Zeitz to Naumburg); 'Bischof von Naumburg' is the bishop as head of it.

decisions.label: Klarenkloster Hof
decisions.gloss_en: convent of St Clare at Hof

decisions.label: Forstei
decisions.note: Generic: the seat of a forestry district, several villages (e.g. pp. 418, 648).

decisions.label: Petrikirche (Erfurt)
decisions.note: Only as a comparison for the tower of the Bergkirche (p. 133).

decisions.label: Marienkirche
decisions.note: Homonyms: the Marienkirche at Nordhausen (p. 133, architectural comparison) and the Marienkirche of Schleiz, i.e. the Bergkirche (p. 582).

decisions.label: Lobensteiner Intelligenzblatt
decisions.note: Local newspaper of Lobenstein, cited as a source for 1785, 1794-1804 (pp. 112, 231, 746).

decisions.label: Christiansglück
decisions.note: Brückner's index: 'Christiansglück (Saaldorf) 727'; locally 'Silberknie' or 'Vitriolwerk'.

decisions.label: Justizamt
decisions.note: Local court of first instance; in the subscribers' list (p. 837) the offices at Gera (I and II), Schleiz (II) and Hohenleuben.

decisions.label: Wanderschule
decisions.note: The 'sog. Wanderschulen' of the 17th century (p. 296); 'eigene Wanderschule' (p. 677).

decisions.label: Agnesschule (Untermhaus)
decisions.gloss_en: Agnesschule (infant school and training for maids), Untermhaus
decisions.note: Founded 10 Nov. 1869 by the reigning prince and princess as a Kleinkinderbewahranstalt, linked with a training school for female servants (p. 422).

decisions.label: Magdeburger Landfeuersocietät
decisions.note: 'magdeburger Feuerversicherungsanstalt' (p. 379) is taken as the same institution. Subscriber: its general direction at Altenhausen (p. 836).

decisions.label: Stift Quedlinburg
decisions.note: Overlord of the Gera area from 999 (p. 320). 'Aebtissin von Quedlinburg' (p. 278, mint at Gera) is the abbess as head of the Stift.

decisions.label: Marienkloster Altenburg
decisions.note: 'Altenburg' (p. 354, 'Klöstern Cronswitz, Lausnitz und Altenburg') and 'altenburger Kloster' (p. 334) are taken as the same Altenburg monastery; the identification is probable, not certain.

decisions.label: Reuß-Köstritz
decisions.note: Paragiat (apanage) side line resident at Köstritz; 'Köstritzer Paragiatherrschaft' is the lordship held by it.

decisions.label: Rutheneum zu Schleiz
decisions.note: Not the Gera school of the same name: the Schleiz Rutheneum, municipal and reorganised 1869 on Prussian lines (p. 586).

decisions.label: Deutsches Haus zu Schleiz
decisions.gloss_en: Teutonic Order commandery (Deutsches Haus) at Schleiz
decisions.note: Commandery of the Teutonic Order at Schleiz; lord of fiefs and church patronage in many villages. After the Reformation its property was administered separately as 'Ordensvermögen' for churches, schools and the poor (p. 588).

decisions.label: Voigtländischer alterthumsforschender Verein zu Hohenleuben
decisions.note: Runs the museum/collections in Schloss Hohenleuben; Brückner also says 'historischer Verein'.

decisions.label: Gesangverein
decisions.note: Generic: choral societies of various places (e.g. Hohenleuben p. 639, p. 687).

decisions.label: Ortskirche
decisions.note: Generic: the church of the village being described.

decisions.label: Schützenverein
decisions.note: Generic: rifle societies of various small towns (pp. 687, 736).

decisions.label: Consistorium zu Gera
decisions.note: Common consistory of the Reuss lands, 1604-1863 (p. 290, 713). Bare 'Consistorium' (pp. 290, 425, 434) and 'das reußische Consistorium' (p. 291) are this one.

decisions.label: Klosteramt (Lobenstein)
decisions.gloss_en: monastery bailiwick (court for the estates of the Saalburg monastery in Lobenstein)
decisions.note: Court/office for the revenues which the Kloster zum heil. Kreuz bei Saalburg held at Lobenstein (p. 721).

decisions.label: Landrathsamt
decisions.note: Administrative district office of the principality; in the subscribers' list (p. 837) the offices at Gera and Ebersdorf.

decisions.label: Herzogthum Nassau
decisions.note: Mentioned p. 3 only as a size comparison.

decisions.label: Fürstenthum Reuß jüngere Linie
decisions.note: Brückner's subject; 'Fürstenthum(s)' alone is the same state.

decisions.label: Catasterbureau
decisions.note: 'Kanzleien' (p. 276) are the two chanceries Rechnungs- und Katasterbureau.

decisions.key: Gesellschaft von Freunden der Naturwissenschaft in Gera und Schleiz

decisions.label: Naturwissenschaftlicher Verein in Schleiz
decisions.note: 'Verein, naturwissenschaftl.' = subscriber at Schleiz (p. 839).

decisions.label: Fürstliche Sammlung inländischer Forstproducte
decisions.gloss_en: princely collection of native forest products

decisions.label: Slaven
decisions.note: Brückner's term for the Slavic (Sorbian) settlers of the 6th/7th centuries (p. 122).

decisions.label: Trinitatiskirche zu Gera
decisions.note: Also called Friedhofskirche, built 1613 at the Gottesacker (p. 432).

decisions.reason: dialect text (spoken line), not an institution

decisions.label: Krankenhausstation
decisions.note: Hohenleuben (p. 169).

decisions.label: Staat
decisions.note: Generic: 'der Staat' (p. 177).

decisions.label: Actien-Stahlgussfabrik (Saale)
decisions.gloss_en: joint-stock cast-steel factory on the Saale (projected 1867)

decisions.label: Alaun- und Vitriolwerk „güldener Hirsch“
decisions.note: Worked 1683-1716 and (as 'Hoff auf Gott') 1779-1804 (p. 245).

decisions.label: Thüringischer Zollverein
decisions.note: 'Hauptsteueramt des thüringischen Zollvereins' (p. 261).

decisions.label: Thüringische Eisenbahn-Gesellschaft
decisions.note: Built the Weißenfels-Gera line (opened 19 March 1859, p. 434).

decisions.label: Bundestag des Deutschen Bundes
decisions.gloss_en: Federal Diet of the German Confederation
decisions.note: 'der ehemalige Bundestag' (p. 264).

decisions.label: Bundesrath des Norddeutschen Bundes
decisions.gloss_en: Federal Council of the North German Confederation

decisions.label: Reichstag des Norddeutschen Bundes
decisions.gloss_en: Reichstag of the North German Confederation

decisions.label: Competenzgerichtshof
decisions.gloss_en: court of competence (conflicts between courts and administration)

decisions.label: Landkrankenhaus zu Jena
decisions.note: 'Direction des großherzoglichen Landkrankenhauses zu Jena' (p. 274).

decisions.reason: title of an official (person), not an institution

decisions.label: Steueramt
decisions.note: Four: Gera, Schleiz, Lobenstein and Hirschberg (p. 277).

decisions.label: Kreisausschuss
decisions.gloss_en: district committee (appeal body in tax matters)

decisions.label: Appellationsgericht zu Eisenach
decisions.note: Court of appeal for the principality (district by treaty of 23 March 1850, p. 281).

decisions.label: Oberappellationsgericht zu Jena
decisions.gloss_en: Higher Court of Appeal at Jena

decisions.label: Kirchen- und Schulcommission
decisions.note: The intermediate authority between the parishes and the Staatsministerium (p. 297); one per Landestheil.

decisions.label: Handelsschule des Dr. Amthor (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: commercial school of Dr. Amthor, Gera

decisions.label: Hospital St. Wolfgang (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: St Wolfgang hospital, Gera ('der arme Spittel')
decisions.note: 'Hospitäler' (p. 833, corrigenda) = the two hospitals united in 1868.

decisions.key: fürstlichen Ministerium Abtheilung für das Innere
decisions.label: Ministerium, Abtheilung für das Innere
Thüringer Brandversicherungsverein
decisions.note: A branch among clergy and teachers (p. 304).

decisions.label: Kirchen- und Schulcommission zu Schleiz
decisions.gloss_en: church and school commission at Schleiz

decisions.label: Kloster Reinhardsbrunn
decisions.note: In the text only as 'der Abt von Reinhardsbrunn' (p. 325).

decisions.reason: generic plural ('Klöster und Ordenshäuser'), no specific institution

decisions.label: Johannesstift Tangermünde
decisions.gloss_en: St John's collegiate foundation at Tangermünde

decisions.label: Gustav-Adolf-Stiftung
decisions.note: 'Gustav-Adolfs-Verein' (p. 639) is the local branch founded 1845 at Hohenleuben.

decisions.label: Landesseminar zu Schleiz
decisions.gloss_en: teachers' seminary of the state at Schleiz

decisions.reason: title of a person (member of the Landtag), not an institution

decisions.label: Kirche von Gera
decisions.note: p. 421: 'Anfänglich wurde die Kirche von Gera aus besorgt' (a chapel served from Gera).

decisions.label: Lesebibliothek
decisions.note: Untermhaus, since 1846 (p. 426).

decisions.label: Hospital beatae virginis Mariae (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: hospital of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Gera ('der reiche Spittel')
decisions.note: 'Marienhospital' (p. 433) is taken as this hospital; the new church of 1782 was built on its former site.

decisions.label: Diaconat
decisions.gloss_en: deaconate (second clergy post and its house)

decisions.label: Weidaische Terminei (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: collecting house (Terminei) of the Weida friars, Gera
decisions.note: Site of the Diaconat at Gera (p. 433).

decisions.label: Sächsisches Telegraphenbureau (Gera)
decisions.note: Merged with the Prussian office in summer 1866 (p. 434).

decisions.label: Preußische Post (Gera)
decisions.note: Taken over from the Thurn und Taxis post on 1 July 1867 (p. 434).

decisions.label: Erste Bürgerschule der Knaben (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: first municipal school for boys, Gera

decisions.label: Rathskreischule (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: council district school (school for the poor), Gera

decisions.label: Gesammtstadtschule (Gera)
decisions.note: 'Gesammststadtschule' (p. 833, corrigenda) is a spelling variant.

decisions.label: Gößnitz-Geraer Bahn
decisions.note: The city of Gera held shares worth 50,000 Thaler (p. 438).

decisions.label: Liedertafel
decisions.note: Generic type; 'die Liedertafel' (p. 440) is the chief choral society of Gera, '2 Liedertafeln' (p. 590) those of Schleiz.

decisions.label: Gallerie Späthe (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: Gallerie Späthe (art and trade exhibition), Gera

decisions.label: v. Wiese’sches Bürgerrettungs- und Industriebeförderungsinstitut (Gera)
decisions.gloss_en: v. Wiese foundation for the rescue of citizens and the promotion of industry, Gera

decisions.reason: descriptive phrase for fiefs, no single entity

decisions.label: Rittergut
decisions.note: Generic: the manor of the village being described (p. 480).

decisions.label: Rittergut Dürrenberg
decisions.note: Index: 'Dürrenberg (Hartmannsdorf) 494'.

decisions.label: Kloster Zella
decisions.note: Brückner's 'Kloster Zella' (p. 575); identification with Altzella not established.

decisions.label: Kalandbrüder (Schleiz)
decisions.note: Met monthly in the Allerheiligenkirche until the Reformation (p. 584).

decisions.label: Kloster des heil. Bonifacius (bei Schleiz)
decisions.gloss_en: monastery of St Boniface near Schleiz
decisions.note: Mentioned p. 585 as a lost religious institution near Schleiz, built about 1280.

decisions.label: Volksleseanstalt für das reußische Oberland
decisions.gloss_en: public reading institution for the Reuss Upland (Schleiz)

decisions.label: Gasthof Sonne (Schleiz)
decisions.note: 'der einzige Gasthof ersten Ranges' (p. 589).

decisions.label: Gasthof Erbprinz (Schleiz)
decisions.note: Formerly 'der berühmte blaue Engel' (p. 589).

decisions.label: Baierischer Hof (Schleiz)
decisions.note: Formerly 'goldener Wolf' (p. 589).

decisions.key: Amte zu Neustadt a. d. Orla
decisions.label: Amt Neustadt an der Orla
Rettungshaus (Hohenleuben)
decisions.gloss_en: rescue home for neglected children, Hohenleuben
decisions.note: Founded 23 March 1853 with a gift of 2300 Thaler (p. 639).

decisions.label: Paragiatsrentamt
decisions.gloss_en: revenue office of the apanage lordship

decisions.label: Sparkasse zu Schleiz
decisions.note: 'Sparkassenverwaltung' (p. 639) is the Hohenleuben branch of the Schleiz savings bank.

decisions.label: Pfarreien Zeulenroda und Leitlitz
decisions.note: Two parishes named together (p. 659).

decisions.label: Stadtkirche
decisions.note: Generic; the town church of Schleiz, Saalburg or Hirschberg, depending on the passage.

decisions.label: Gotteshaus zu Schleiz
decisions.note: Held Erbgerichte in villages near Saalburg (p. 677); 'Gotteshaushaus' is a variant spelling.

decisions.reason: demonym (inhabitants of Saalburg), not an institution

decisions.label: Gasthof „die Kapelle“
decisions.note: Locally 'die Kappel' (p. 692).

decisions.label: Deutscher Orden zu Zwätzen
decisions.note: Lord of the fief of the church in the village described on p. 698, until the Reformation.

decisions.label: Rittergut Frankendorf
decisions.note: Named together with Seubtendorf (p. 700).

decisions.label: Haus Gera
decisions.note: 'Gera' (p. 571, 'Dynasten Lobdaburg und Gera') and 'Voigten von Gera' (p. 636) refer to the dynasts.

decisions.label: Haus der Burggrafen von Plauen
decisions.gloss_en: House of the Burgraves of Plauen

decisions.label: Erzbisthum Magdeburg
decisions.note: 'die magdeburger Kirche' as the higher church authority over the naumburger Bisthum before the Reformation (p. 713).

decisions.label: Ministerium, Abtheilung für Kirchen- und Schulangelegenheiten
decisions.gloss_en: Ministry, department of church and school affairs

decisions.reason: title of an official (person), not an institution

decisions.label: Post
decisions.note: Bare post offices and post stations; the Prussian post at Gera is a separate entry.

decisions.label: Amtsgericht (Lobenstein)
decisions.note: Fragment of 'Amts-, Stadt-, Pfarr- und Hospitalgerichte' (p. 721); completed.

decisions.label: Stadtgericht (Lobenstein)
decisions.note: Fragment of 'Amts-, Stadt-, Pfarr- und Hospitalgerichte' (p. 721); completed.

decisions.label: Pfarrgericht (Lobenstein)
decisions.note: Fragment of 'Amts-, Stadt-, Pfarr- und Hospitalgerichte' (p. 721); completed.

decisions.label: Spaniershammer
decisions.note: Index: 'Spaniershammer (Saaldorf) 728'.

decisions.label: Neuhammer
decisions.note: Index: 'Neuhammer (Saaldorf) 727'; at the Saale below the Muckenberg. A second Neuhammer lies near Lobenstein.

decisions.label: Canzlei
decisions.note: 'der Canzlei, dem Amte und dem Rittergute Haueisen' (p. 725), presumably the chancery at Lobenstein.

decisions.label: Amt
decisions.note: Bare 'dem Amte' (p. 725) without a place name.

decisions.label: Volksbibliothek
decisions.note: Ebersdorf, founded 1866 by the princess (p. 736).

decisions.label: Waisenhausanstalt (Ebersdorf)
decisions.gloss_en: orphanage institution of the Moravian congregation at Ebersdorf

decisions.label: Unitätsdirection (Herrnhut/Berthelsdorf)
decisions.gloss_en: Moravian Unity directorate at Berthelsdorf near Herrnhut

decisions.label: Consistorium der Unitäts-Aeltesten-Conferenz
decisions.gloss_en: consistory of the Moravian Elders' Conference (Berthelsdorf)

decisions.label: Knaben-Pensionsanstalt (Ebersdorf)
decisions.gloss_en: boys' boarding school of the Moravian congregation at Ebersdorf

decisions.label: Schwesternhaus
decisions.note: Girls' school of the Ebersdorf Moravians (p. 738).

decisions.label: St. Marienkirche zu Erfurt (Marienstift)
decisions.gloss_en: collegiate church of St Mary at Erfurt
decisions.note: Only as 'der Probst der St. Marienkirche zu Erfurt' (p. 756): the collegiate chapter, not the building.

decisions.reason: adjective from a noble family name, no entity
adjective from a noble family name, no entity

decisions.label: Heinrichshütte
decisions.note: Index: 'Heinrichshütte (Wurzbach) 770'.

decisions.label: Waldrittergut Arlas
decisions.note: Consolidated with Blankenstein (p. 804).

decisions.label: Fiedlers Baumwollenspinnfabrik
decisions.note: Founded 1829, first as Heynisch's mill (p. 784).

decisions.label: St. Annakloster (Hof)
decisions.note: 'Klöster zu Hof' (p. 794) names the Hof monasteries, of which the St. Annakloster is singled out.

decisions.key: Kloster zum heil. Kreuz bei Saalburg

decisions.label: Brandenburg-Baireuth
decisions.note: In the text 'das hohenzollersche markgräfliche Haus Brandenburg-Baireuth' (pp. 797, 811): the margravial house and its territory.

decisions.label: Rittergut Blankenberg
decisions.note: Patron of the church at Blankenberg (p. 804).

decisions.reason: title of a person (lord of Hirschberg castle), not an institution
demonym (inhabitants of Hirschberg), not an institution

decisions.label: Gesellschaft von Freunden der Naturwissenschaften in Gera
decisions.gloss_en: Society of Friends of the Natural Sciences, Gera
decisions.note: Publisher of Jahresberichte since 1858. The variants name the same society; 'naturwissenschaftlicher Verein' (p. 441, in the Gera town description) is taken as this society. The Schleiz society is a separate entry.

decisions.label: Rosenthal
decisions.note: 'Die Spinnfabrik zu Blankenstein führt den Namen Rosenthal' (p. 834, corrigenda).

decisions.label: Großherzogliche Bibliothek (Weimar)
decisions.note: Subscriber, p. 836.

decisions.label: Hauptsteueramt
decisions.note: Turned in 1867 into a Hauptsteueramt of the Thuringian Zollverein (p. 261).

decisions.label: Mitscher & Röstell (Berlin)
decisions.note: Subscriber, p. 838.

decisions.label: v. Puttkammer & Mühlbrecht (Berlin)
decisions.note: Subscriber, p. 838.
